t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I believe the strategy to follow in the 1st round before the break is to locate options between the short yellow hat and the tall brown hat. If the options arent there, best is to go with the short yellow cat and collect more mushrooms. in the second round, you need to choose all the tall brown caps to get more mushrooms if what I have gathered from the advice given

vb_textbox.text: I chose my strategy based on the colours of the hats mostly as I noticed a pattern there. Whenever I was with 1x chances and was presented with both men with hats. if they were both short, I chose the hat with the less stand out color. If one was taller than the other, I chose the shorter one.For the 5x rounds, I chose any of them (either short and tall) depending on the color of their hat, i noticed i collected more points at the 5x rounds when choosing vibrant colors suh as pink, purple, blue.
